title: Work for binary row construction
statement: For coefficient-vector length $\ell$, define the work recursively on the output dimension: it is zero at dimension zero, and at dimension $n+1$ it is the work at dimension $n$ plus the power-construction work for exponent $n+1$, plus twice the traversal work over the indices $0,\ldots,\ell-1$, plus one.
caveat: The referenced power-construction work and traversal-work definitions are not included in this payload, so their precise meanings cannot be independently rendered.
